title: Stasis & Supplies Shop
description: A mysterious figure in a dark blue cloak and wide-brimmed hat stands at the entrance of an old European-style shop, holding an open book and pointing at the doorway. The shop is labeled 'STASIS & SUPPLIES' with an open book sign above the door, surrounded by potion bottles, dried herbs, scales, scrolls, and glowing butterflies on the stone steps.
prompt: A hooded figure in a dark blue cloak and pointed hat stands before an ancient wooden shop at dusk, holding an open book and gesturing toward the door. The shop sign is an open book reading 'STASIS & SUPPLIES'. Potion bottles labeled 'LOCKED HOUSE' and 'STASIS' sit on shelves with dried lavender hanging above. Brass scales, scrolls, and glowing blue butterflies rest on the stone steps. Narrow European alley with warm sunset sky in the background, atmospheric and detailed fantasy painting.
